        # Calculate the position of the dirigible at the given time
        if time <= t:
            vx, vy = wind1
        else:
            vx, vy = wind2

        # Calculate the displacement due to the wind
        x_displacement = vx * time
        y_displacement = vy * time

        else:
            low = mid
